A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Ouroboros work, and all 13 pages are readable and comparable, including equations, figures, tables, and references. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix or embedded supplementary files, although supplementary material is mentioned.

before.justification: v2 reports original Ouroboros experiments on inverse and forward rendering in Tables 1–5, alongside qualitative video results and training ablations.

after.justification: v3 retains the original rendering evaluations in Tables 1–5, qualitative video results, and training ablations. These remain original empirical results of the work.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1–4.3 retain identical single-step diffusion finetuning, task-specific losses, cycle training, and video inference procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use Hypersim, InteriorVerse, and MatrixCity for rendering experiments, MSCOCO and Flickr30k for additional cycle training, and the same qualitative video scenarios. Dataset and task coverage are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in each corresponding table and visual comparison. Tables 1–5 retain RGB↔X and the same task-specific comparisons with Zhu et al., Kocsis et al., IntrinsicAnything, Careaga and Aksoy, Lotus, StableNormal, E2E, and Du et al.

E3.justification: Training sample counts, test datasets, dataset-specific input channels, and evaluation metrics remain identical in Sections 4–5. No experimental protocol or setting is revised.

E4.justification: Section 5.4 and Figures 6, 8, and 9 retain the same qualitative ablations of e2e loss, cycle training, and wild-data finetuning. The other qualitative analyses are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests for its experiments. No statistical reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–5 and all graphical and qualitative results are unchanged. For example, Ouroboros retains Hypersim albedo PSNR 18.98 in Table 1 and MatrixCity forward-rendering PSNR 21.57 in Table 5.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(9), their definitions, and the associated mathematical reasoning are identical. No formal assumption, derivation, theorem, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and discussion retain the same claims about rendering quality, 50× inference acceleration, cycle consistency, heterogeneous-data training, and training-free video decomposition.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning lighting reconstruction, material understanding, and generalization are unchanged. Section 6 retains the same limitations involving training-data quantity, unreliable intrinsic maps, and inaccurate lighting information.

D1.justification: The abstract's project-page address changes from siwensun.github.io/ouroboros-project/ to y-research-sbu.github.io/Ouroboros/. This updates access information; the PDFs do not establish any change in resource availability or contents. Implementation disclosures are otherwise identical.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and all 89 references are unchanged, as is the positioning relative to RGB↔X, E2E, DiffusionRenderer, and cycle-consistency approaches.

P1.justification: Only the first-page project URL and arXiv version/date stamp change, from v2 dated 7 October 2025 to v3 dated 20 April 2026. All other wording and section organization remain identical.

P2.justification: All nine figures and five tables retain identical content, captions, formatting, and placement. Rendered pages 2–13 are identical, and the first-page text substitutions do not change the layout.

improvement.justification: The project-link and version-stamp updates leave the scientific argument, empirical support, limitations, and readability unchanged. The PDFs document no accompanying resource improvement, so the revision produces no meaningful net change in paper quality.
